sentences.text: The institution of this writ petition is coming as a sequel to OWP No. 590 of 2009 bearing the grievance of the petitioner with respect to the rate of compensation of the land which was under state of requisition with the Govt. of India, Ministry of Defence but has not yet seen closure of acquisition.

02. Learned counsel for the petitioner draws the attention of this Court to annexure-II (page 13)
which is communication No. 502/Arbitrator/RAIP Act/22/1873 dated 07.01.2023 from the end of the Divisional Commissioner, Jammu to the Commissioner/ Secretary to Govt., Revenue Department, Civil Secretariat, Jammu with respect to appointment of arbitrator under the Requisitioning and Acquisition of Immovable Property Act.
03. Issue notice to the respondents.

sentences.text: 04. Petitioner to furnish registered postal covers for the service of the respondents within a period of seven days, whereupon the Registrar Judicial, Jammu to issue notice to the respondents.
In the meantime, tag the record of writ petition OWP No. 590 of 2009 with the present writ petition.
